title: Greece and Egypt coastal city sprite water-orientation and azure harmonization review
camera: elevated oblique looking north from south; never horizontally flip cities
scope: Existing city PNG variants and cartographic shorelines; avoid broad replacement of working artwork
rules: Use coast geometry and city footprint instead of generic western-sea assumptions
Keep maritime water in the same azure family as current base map; color harmonization is not evidence of correct coast fit
Remove duplicate painted sea portions where a city overlaps the mapped water body; preserve harbor architecture, docks, walls and land access
Preserve alpha transparency outside the footprint; no rectangular or opaque sea backgrounds
Render original-versus-candidate side by side within map coastline at print scale before promotion
Record source-year and historical uncertainty; do not silently substitute a later fortification for an 1180 depiction
Do not alter production sprite selection until coast-mask intersection and owner review are complete
